senses.gloss: m.(b. h.;contr. of <cite ref="L00619"><he>לעל</he></cite>, apocop. of <he>לעלע</he> = <he>עלעל</he>, cmp. formation of <cite ref="K00934"><he>כֶּסֶךְ</he></cite>; cmp. <cite ref="P00815"><he>עָלל</he></cite>, <cite ref="P00831"><he>עִלְעוֹל</he></cite>, <he>עִלְעֵל</he> I)
winding pathway, passage way, esp. a small room with a staircase leading up to the upper rooms (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. House, Amer. ed. 1858, p. 519ᵃ).
units: <cite ref="Menachot 34a:3">Men. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>ל׳ פתוח מן הבית לעליה</he> a small room opening (leading) from the ground floor to the upper room.

<cite ref="Pesachim 34a:9">Pes. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>ל׳ קטן היה וכ׳</he> there was a small passage way between the graded ascent (<cite ref="K00084"><he>כֶּבֶשׁ</he></cite>) and the altar; <cite ref="Pesachim 77a:18">ib. 77ᵃ</cite> (<cite ref="Zevachim 62b:13">Zeb. 62ᵇ</cite> <he>אויר</he>; <cite ref="Zevachim 104a">ib. 104ᵃ</cite> <he>ריוח</he>).—Pl. <he>לוּלִים</he>, <cite ref="L00279"><he>לוּלִין</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 7:1:3">Y. Erub. VII, beg. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>מהו לערב דרך ל׳</he> how about connecting two dwellings for Sabbath purposes by the way of the staircases (leading to the roofs)?—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 1:1:18">Y. Yoma I, 38ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:12:5">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ל׳ אלו ע״ג אלו וכ׳</he> staircases above each other (well-hole) require M’zuzah, (to be furnished by him) who has the right of use of the lower threshold.
<cite ref="Pesachim 8a">Pes. 8ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 11a">Yoma 11ᵃ</cite> <he>ל׳ ומתבן</he> the staircase rooms and the provision room; [comment. refer to Nr. 3, v. infra].

<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 4:5">Midd. IV, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 26a:4">Pes. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>ול׳ היו פתוחין וכ׳</he> there were small passages in the loft leading to the Holy of Holies through which mechanics were lowered in boxes (closed elevators).

senses.gloss: (anat.) a passage from the vestibulum vaginae (פרוזדור).

units: <cite ref="Shabbat 102b:6">Sabb. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>העושה נקב בל׳ וכ׳</he> he who makes a hole (for ventilation) in a hen-roost; <cite ref="Shabbat 146a:12">ib. 146ᵃ</cite> <he>משום ל׳ של וכ׳</he> in order to prevent making a hole in a hen-roost which is done for ventilation.
<cite ref="Pesachim 8a">Pes. 8ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 11a">Yoma 11ᵃ</cite> <he>ל׳ ומתבן</he> hen-roosts &c., v. supra.
